items.title: Hormel Foods cuts annual sales forecast as sluggish consumer demand weighs
items.summary: Hormel Foods has lowered its annual sales forecast due to a decline in its retail segment and weak demand for private-label snack nuts, reflecting broader inflationary pressures and higher living costs impacting consumer spending. Despite the sales challenges, the company raised its full-year adjusted earnings per share forecast, following strategic portfolio adjustments and new executive appointments. Its third-quarter revenue missed analyst estimates, primarily due to weaker performance in retail and international businesses.

items.title: Assisted by Halliburton, Two Startups Slash Costs of Critical Minerals Refining
items.summary: Halliburton Labs, a subsidiary of Halliburton Company, is collaborating with two startups, Electroflow Technologies and SiTration Inc., to significantly reduce the costs and processing steps for critical minerals. Electroflow has developed a three-step process for extracting and refining lithium from brines, while SiTration offers a single-step method for recovering copper from mining waste streams. This initiative highlights the oil industry's increasing diversification into critical minerals, driven by energy security concerns and shifting political incentives.

items.title: America’s Industrial Comeback Requires a New Financial Playbook and a Fatter Checkbook
items.summary: Jim Zelter, President of Apollo Global Management, argues that America's industrial comeback, driven by investments in power, infrastructure, manufacturing, and critical supply chains, demands a new financial approach and significant capital. He emphasizes that rebuilding the industrial base will require trillions of dollars and a more connected capital system to finance this transformation. The article highlights Apollo's role as a principal investor providing flexible capital solutions for leading companies globally.

items.title: Why Is Hormel Foods Stock Falling Thursday? - Hormel Foods (NYSE:HRL)
items.summary: Hormel Foods (NYSE: HRL) stock fell after reporting mixed fiscal third-quarter results. While adjusted earnings beat estimates, sales missed expectations, and the company noted continued pressure on consumers due to inflation and fuel costs. Hormel updated its fiscal 2026 outlook, raising its adjusted earnings forecast but lowering its annual sales outlook, anticipating choppy consumer conditions to persist.

items.title: Enphase Energy (NASDAQ:ENPH) stock moves as home-solar demand stays in view
items.summary: Enphase Energy's stock moved as the broader energy sector firmed due to strengthening crude prices, highlighting renewed interest in home-solar demand. The company, known for its microinverters and home-battery systems, benefits from themes of energy security and self-reliance, especially as residential electricity consumption continues to rise. Enphase positions itself at the forefront of distributed home energy systems, leveraging its integrated hardware and software to offer resilient and intelligent power solutions amidst competitive market dynamics.

items.title: GE Aerospace: Full-Throttle Ahead, Full Valuation, Technical Froth Eases (NYSE:GE)
items.summary: GE Aerospace reported strong Q2 results with significant revenue and EPS growth, leading management to raise its full-year 2026 guidance across all key metrics. Despite robust execution and upward earnings revisions, the author maintains a "Hold" rating due to the stock's full valuation, evidenced by a 35x P/E and a 2.5x PEG ratio. While technical indicators show a bullish trend with a rising 200-day moving average, recent negative RSI divergence and seasonal risks suggest caution for investors.

items.title: Masco stock trades in low-$70s range as valuation and earnings narrative evolves
items.summary: Masco stock is currently trading in the low-$70s range, below a consensus target of nearly $80, despite positive valuation commentary and recent product launches from its Behr brand. The market is weighing Masco's earnings trajectory, margin trends, and its discounted price-to-earnings multiple compared to industry averages. Investors are watching to see if new product initiatives, especially from Behr paint, will help the stock converge toward its target price and peer valuations.

items.title: lululemon Q2 Earnings Upcoming: Is It Likely to Surprise Investors?
items.summary: lululemon Athletica Inc. (LULU) is expected to report declines in both top and bottom lines for Q2 fiscal 2026, with revenue growth projected at 2.3% and EPS expected to drop by 42.3%. While the company has a history of earnings surprises and strong international growth, especially in Mainland China, it faces significant headwinds from softening demand in North America and margin pressures due to higher markdowns and increased SG&A expenses. The Zacks model does not predict an earnings beat for LULU this quarter.
